interpretation: Frozen τ≈26.73 from DEV p99.5 met both DEV provisional gates (abrupt 6h=1.00, unmatched/wk=2.55) with short episodes (no latch signature). On DIAG (diagnostic; prior examination): burden stayed low (unmatched/wk=0.08, union≈1.3%) but useful abrupt 6h recall fell to 1/3 (p158 only; p183/p369 missed). Null short-window abrupt counts can diverge from primary recall when wide-window incipient matching consumes episodes. Leak-associated DIAG excursions are not reliably extreme enough vs the DEV historical percentile bar for useful timed alerts.
recommendation: **No-go:** frozen empirical τ loses useful six-hour abrupt sensitivity on DIAG.
holdout_honesty: DIAG is diagnostic given prior examination; not an untouched holdout. Threshold not recomputed from DIAG percentiles. 2019 not evaluated.
